findings.highlight: a cat about to pounce on her prey and tear it apart
findings.evidenceJa: 近づいた途端鼠を八つ裂きにする猫
findings.governingReading: a cat that tears a mouse to pieces the instant it approaches
findings.explanation: The trigger and immediacy of Rin’s predatory aura are replaced by an anticipated pounce.

findings.highlight: I ignore her
findings.evidenceJa: 背中にかかるあくまの声
findings.governingReading: shaking off the devil’s voice cast at my back
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic recasting of Rin as a pursuing devil disappears.

findings.highlight: I ignore her and run into the hallway
findings.evidenceJa: 振り切って廊下へ走る
findings.governingReading: I shake off her pursuit and run into the corridor
findings.explanation: Active escape from Rin’s pursuing voice is reduced to ignoring her.

findings.highlight: Someone screams in joy
findings.evidenceJa: 雄叫びが上がる
findings.governingReading: a roar goes up
findings.explanation: Unsupported joy is added to the anonymous masculine roar.

findings.highlight: something like that
findings.evidenceJa: ああいう物騒な言い回し
findings.governingReading: that sort of alarming, violent phrasing
findings.explanation: The reason the girls recoil—the mock-violent phrasing—is generalized away.

findings.highlight: move their desks to the corner
findings.evidenceJa: 机を四隅に寄せていく
findings.governingReading: move their desks toward the four corners
findings.explanation: The coordinated spatial image is reduced to a single corner.

findings.highlight: The croquette tastes just like meat
findings.evidenceJa: コロッケ定食なのになに食べても肉の味しかしねえ
findings.governingReading: though it is a croquette set, everything you eat tastes only of meat
findings.explanation: The joke that every component tastes exclusively of meat is reduced to the croquette tasting like meat.

findings.highlight: that might be enough for you
findings.evidenceJa: それが得なのかどうかは個人の趣味嗜好
findings.governingReading: whether that is a bargain depends on personal taste
findings.explanation: A judgment about whether the meat effect is advantageous becomes whether it is sufficient for one speaker.

findings.highlight: The amount of people who go to the cafeteria depends on if you brought your lunch
findings.evidenceJa: 弁当かどうかで学食組が激変する
findings.governingReading: whether you brought a lunch drastically changes the cafeteria group
findings.explanation: The social effect of Shirou’s lunches is rendered in malformed, impersonal English.

findings.highlight: Make some lunch for me sometime, will you?
findings.evidenceJa: 弁当作ってくれぞなもし
findings.governingReading: make me a lunch, if you please
findings.explanation: The boy’s deliberately absurd archaic/comic sentence ending is neutralized.

findings.highlight: You just pour water on it and heat it up
findings.evidenceJa: お湯で温めるだけ
findings.governingReading: you only warm it in hot water
findings.explanation: The girl’s joke that tamagoyaki is a heat-in-water convenience product becomes an unclear two-step recipe.

findings.highlight: I won’t have time to make lunch
findings.evidenceJa: ここんところ弁当作ってる余裕ない
findings.governingReading: I have not had the time to make lunches lately
findings.explanation: A current ongoing shortage of time is shifted into a future prediction.

findings.highlight: The people that didn’t bring their lunch
findings.evidenceJa: 学食組と購買組
findings.governingReading: the cafeteria group and school-store group
findings.explanation: Two distinct lunch factions are collapsed into everyone without a homemade lunch.

findings.highlight: The guys come back, arguing
findings.evidenceJa: 男連中と肉の味がするミックス定食を完食し、エビフライまでミートテイストなのはどうかと口論しながら戻ってきた
findings.governingReading: I finished the meat-tasting mixed set with the guys and returned while arguing
findings.explanation: Shirou’s completed meal and his own return with the group are omitted.

findings.highlight: The guys come back
findings.evidenceJa: 戻ってきた
findings.governingReading: I came back with the guys
findings.explanation: The return focalized through Shirou is assigned only to the other boys.

findings.highlight: She must have disguised her handwriting
findings.evidenceJa: 文字は定規で書かれている
findings.governingReading: the characters are drawn with a ruler, perhaps to alter the handwriting as a precaution
findings.explanation: A visible production method and Shirou’s tentative inference become a certain claim about an unidentified woman’s intent.

findings.highlight: She’s the only one that would know about “this morning”
findings.evidenceJa: 朝の事って、該当するのはあいつ以外いない
findings.governingReading: the reference to this morning can apply to no one but her
findings.explanation: Referential elimination is changed into Rin uniquely possessing knowledge.

findings.highlight: She must know I can see the words she scribbled out… Or maybe not
findings.evidenceJa: 塗り潰した部分が透けて見えるのまで計算してる……ってワケじゃないよな
findings.governingReading: surely she did not calculate even the fact that the blacked-out portion remains visible
findings.explanation: A disbelieving question about deliberate design begins as a confident statement that Rin knows the result.

findings.highlight: I’ll consult Tohsaka about it
findings.evidenceJa: 失敗覚悟で遠坂に相談してみよう
findings.governingReading: I will try consulting Tohsaka, prepared for it to fail
findings.explanation: Shirou’s expectation that seeking Rin’s help may fail is omitted.

findings.highlight: I can take cover there
findings.evidenceJa: 人気のある場所まで逃げればいい
findings.governingReading: I can flee to any populated place
findings.explanation: Shirou’s general refuge among witnesses is narrowed to taking cover at the archery club.

findings.highlight: Miyama City is located in a valley between mountains
findings.evidenceJa: 深山町はその名の通り、山間に出来た町
findings.governingReading: Miyama Town, true to its name, was built among the mountains
findings.explanation: The place-name explanation, town status, and mountain-settlement relation are lost.

findings.highlight: this school is on one of them
findings.evidenceJa: その山の一つがこの学校
findings.governingReading: one of those mountains is this school
findings.explanation: The compressed identification of the school grounds with one of the town’s mountains becomes ordinary placement on a mountain.

findings.highlight: even the athletic clubs
findings.evidenceJa: 日夜新しいマラソンコース開発に余念がない運動部
findings.governingReading: the athletic clubs, tirelessly developing new marathon routes day and night
findings.explanation: The comic reason these clubs would know remote terrain is omitted.

findings.highlight: never enter
findings.evidenceJa: 滅多に入らない
findings.governingReading: rarely enter
findings.explanation: A low-frequency action is made absolute.

findings.highlight: A furious demon awaits me
findings.evidenceJa: 一人、ご機嫌ななめで待ち受ける大魔神
findings.governingReading: one Great Demon God waits there alone in a displeased mood
findings.explanation: The mock-grand title, singular staging, and Rin’s sulky displeasure are compressed into generic fury.

findings.highlight: Maybe this wasn’t such a good idea. I ought to go home
findings.evidenceJa: いますぐ帰りたくなった
findings.governingReading: I wanted to go home immediately
findings.explanation: A direct immediate impulse is prefaced with unsupported doubt about the plan.

findings.highlight: My voice echoes through the woods
findings.evidenceJa: かー、かー、かー、と雑木林に響く声
findings.governingReading: my voice echoes kaa, kaa, kaa through the woods
findings.explanation: The echo’s crowlike sound pattern is omitted.

findings.highlight: Don’t shout my name so loudly
findings.evidenceJa: 人の名前連呼するな
findings.governingReading: do not keep shouting my name
findings.explanation: Rin objects to repeated invocation; the English makes volume the only offense.

findings.highlight: Her voice echoes even longer than mine
findings.evidenceJa: 反響は俺の時より二回も多い
findings.governingReading: her echo repeats two more times than mine
findings.explanation: A counted comic difference becomes unmeasured duration.

findings.highlight: you got me carried away again
findings.evidenceJa: また調子狂わされた
findings.governingReading: you threw me off my rhythm again
findings.explanation: Rin’s complaint that Shirou disrupts her composure becomes a claim that he excited or emboldened her.

findings.highlight: Gritting her teeth
findings.evidenceJa: チ、と舌打ちして
findings.governingReading: clicking her tongue
findings.explanation: Rin’s small gesture of irritation is replaced with a stronger, unsupported physical action.

findings.highlight: your harmfulness that’s taken as harmless
findings.evidenceJa: 無害さを装った有害さ
findings.governingReading: the harmfulness you disguise as harmlessness
findings.explanation: Shirou’s harmless presentation masking harmful effects becomes harm that other people merely perceive as harmless.

findings.highlight: so mutated you could kill a wolf
findings.evidenceJa: 狼を返り討ちにする突然変異
findings.governingReading: a mutation that turns the tables on a wolf attacking it
findings.explanation: The sheep’s surprising counter-defeat is strengthened into killing the wolf.

findings.highlight: it doesn’t really matter what she thinks of it
findings.evidenceJa: 個人の趣味嗜好の範疇なので文句はない
findings.governingReading: it falls within the realm of personal taste, so I cannot complain
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mock-tolerant classification of Rin’s threatening-note style becomes indifference to her opinion.

findings.highlight: the image in my head of Tohsaka Rin crumbles to dust
findings.evidenceJa: イメージが更に崩れていく
findings.governingReading: my image of “Tohsaka Rin” erodes still further
findings.explanation: Gradual additional erosion is exaggerated into total destruction.

findings.highlight: you didn’t have to change your handwriting
findings.evidenceJa: 定規で書かなくてもよかった
findings.governingReading: you did not have to write it with a ruler
findings.explanation: The physical joke and evidence from the note are replaced by an inferred purpose.

findings.highlight: I thought I had to write something extra to make you come here
findings.evidenceJa: それぐらいしないと捕まえられないと思った
findings.governingReading: I thought I could not catch you unless I went that far
findings.explanation: Rin’s estimate of the force needed to catch fleeing Shirou becomes unspecified additional writing.

findings.highlight: I don’t care if you think it’s a threat
findings.evidenceJa: 脅迫状でも犯行声明でもザンカン状でも好きにいいなさい
findings.governingReading: call it a threat letter, a criminal declaration, or a manifesto punishing evil—whatever you like
findings.explanation: Rin’s escalating comic list of accusatory document genres is removed.

findings.highlight: She looks away angrily
findings.evidenceJa: 明後日の方角に顔を背ける
findings.governingReading: turns her face away toward the day after tomorrow
findings.explanation: The absurd directional exaggeration is lost and unsupported anger is supplied.

findings.highlight: the memo sounded like a threat
findings.evidenceJa: いささか物騒だった
findings.governingReading: the note was somewhat alarming
findings.explanation: Shirou’s qualified relief that Rin recognizes the note’s tone is strengthened into her accepting his threat-letter label.

findings.highlight: I decided to hear you out
findings.evidenceJa: わざわざ聞いてあげる気になった
findings.governingReading: I went out of my way and deigned to hear you out
findings.explanation: Rin’s defensive emphasis on her effort and condescending favor is neutralized.

findings.highlight: if you don’t want to talk about it
findings.evidenceJa: わたしには話せない事なら
findings.governingReading: if it is something you cannot tell me
findings.explanation: A constraint on what Shirou can confide becomes lack of desire to speak.

findings.highlight: I’m not angry now
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の顔見たら怒りも失せた
findings.governingReading: seeing your face made my anger disappear
findings.explanation: The sight of Shirou directly softening Rin’s anger is omitted.

findings.highlight: I really do need to consult you
findings.evidenceJa: こっちから遠坂に相談したかったぐらい
findings.governingReading: I had actually wanted to consult you myself
findings.explanation: Shirou’s surprise that his own intended request was invited by Rin becomes generic necessity.

findings.highlight: family of magidid you know
findings.evidenceJa: 間桐の家はもともと魔術師の家系らしいんだが
findings.governingReading: family of magi—did you know
findings.explanation: Missing separation merges “magi” and “did,” visibly corrupting the sentence.

findings.highlight: He doesn’t have a Magic Circuit, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術使いとしての最低条件である魔術回路
findings.governingReading: he lacks Magic Circuits, the minimum condition even for a practitioner of Magecraft
findings.explanation: The distinction from magus and the stated minimum threshold are removed.

findings.highlight: His book, his Command Spell
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二の本
findings.governingReading: Shinji’s book, read here as his Command Spell
findings.explanation: The base text and its explanatory ruby are rendered as two separate objects.

findings.highlight: Sakura has to live with him
findings.evidenceJa: あいつの家には桜がいる
findings.governingReading: Sakura is in his house
findings.explanation: Sakura’s location in the Matou home becomes an unsupported claim of compelled cohabitation.

findings.highlight: magic only gets taught to the successor
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術ってのは後継者にしか教えない
findings.governingReading: Magecraft is taught only to the successor
findings.explanation: The technical category Magecraft is again generalized to magic.

findings.highlight: The other Masters are tricky
findings.evidenceJa: 他の連中はどうもきな臭い
findings.governingReading: the other parties smell suspicious
findings.explanation: Rin’s suspicion of unexplained activity is changed into a settled assessment of tactical trickiness.

findings.highlight: I doubt she wants to stay at my house
findings.evidenceJa: 嫌がるに決まってる
findings.governingReading: she is certain to dislike being told to stay from today
findings.explanation: Shirou’s certainty about Sakura’s refusal and the abrupt same-day demand are weakened.

findings.highlight: Just go ahead and ask her
findings.evidenceJa: ダメもとで訊いてみなさい
findings.governingReading: ask her even if you expect it to fail
findings.explanation: Rin explicitly tells Shirou to try despite poor odds; that practical framing disappears.

findings.highlight: before I start worrying about what I think
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の気持ちを気にする前に
findings.governingReading: before I presume to worry about Sakura’s feelings
findings.explanation: The feelings under consideration are reassigned from Sakura to Shirou.

findings.highlight: people who have gone into comas
findings.evidenceJa: 原因不明の昏睡事件
findings.governingReading: the unexplained coma incidents
findings.explanation: The defining lack of an identified cause is omitted.

findings.highlight: cunning enemies
findings.evidenceJa: 厄介な相手
findings.governingReading: a troublesome opponent
findings.explanation: Unsupported cunning replaces the broader difficulty of the Ryuudou Temple faction.

findings.highlight: the wound Archer suffered
findings.evidenceJa: 誰かさんにやられた傷
findings.governingReading: the wound inflicted on Archer by a certain someone
findings.explanation: Rin’s pointed jab at Shirou as the person responsible disappears.

findings.highlight: I stop Tohsaka, but
findings.evidenceJa: 呼び止めるが
findings.governingReading: I call after her to stop her, but
findings.explanation: An unsuccessful attempt to stop Rin is stated as a successful stop, contradicting her departure.
